course.title.note: Follows KEY_TERMS suggestion 'Khám phá thế giới của chúng ta'. Alternative 'quanh ta' is warmer; reviewer decides.

course.description.note: 'Khoa học xã hội' follows KEY_TERMS; Vietnamese schools say 'Lịch sử và Địa lí', so check this reads right to a family in Vietnam and abroad. 'Đời sống công dân' for 'civic life': check it is not stiff.
course.description.source: A free social studies course with 24 lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life.
course.description.back: A free social science course with 24 lessons on history, geography, culture and civic life.

sections.0.title.note: Suggested section name from KEY_TERMS. Check 'những câu chuyện của loài người' is natural.
sections.0.title.back: History and the stories of humankind

sections.0.question.note: Long abstract question; 'định hình' (shape) is somewhat formal. Check it reads smoothly to a 12-year-old.
sections.0.question.source: How have people, ideas, and events shaped the world we live in?
sections.0.question.back: How have people, ideas and events shaped the world we live in?

sections.0.description.source: Explore how people, ideas, inventions, movement, and trade have shaped the world.
sections.0.description.back: Explore how people, ideas, inventions, movement and trade have shaped the world.

sections.1.question.source: How do places shape people's lives, and how do people shape places?
sections.1.question.back: How do places shape people's lives, and how do people shape places?

sections.1.description.note: 'Tài nguyên' for 'resources' follows KEY_TERMS; check it is clear here (natural resources) and in the Civics section (things you use, e.g. a tablet).
sections.1.description.source: Understand maps, places, resources, climate, cities, and the relationship between people and the environment.
sections.1.description.back: Learn about maps, places, resources, climate, cities and the relationship between people and the environment.

sections.2.title.note: 'Bản sắc' for 'identity' follows KEY_TERMS but is abstract. Check a simpler word is not wanted.

sections.2.question.source: How do people create meaning, community, and belonging?
sections.2.question.back: How do people create meaning, community and a sense of belonging?

sections.2.description.note: Long list; check the rhythm of 'qua ngôn ngữ, truyền thống, nghệ thuật, đời sống hằng ngày và những trải nghiệm chung'.
sections.2.description.source: Learn how communities create meaning through language, traditions, art, everyday life, and shared experiences.
sections.2.description.back: Learn how communities create meaning through language, traditions, art, everyday life and shared experiences.

sections.3.question.note: Long sentence; 'cộng đồng công bằng hơn' for 'fairer communities': check tone.
sections.3.question.source: How do people make choices, use resources, and build fairer communities together?
sections.3.question.back: How do people make choices, use resources and together build fairer communities?

sections.3.description.note: 'Youth' rendered 'những bạn trẻ' (friendly) instead of 'thanh thiếu niên' (formal). Reviewer decides. 'Hiểu biết về truyền thông' for 'media literacy' is a paraphrase; check there is no standard shorter term. | Review: 'hiểu biết về truyền thông' for 'media literacy' is acceptable; reviewer may prefer 'năng lực truyền thông'.
sections.3.description.source: Explore everyday economics, media literacy, and how youth can contribute to their communities.
sections.3.description.back: Explore everyday economics, media understanding and how young people can contribute to their communities.

practiceOptions.0.back: I practised with a classmate/study partner

practiceOptions.3.source: I practised another way (quietly, with sign, or in writing)
practiceOptions.3.back: I practised another way (silently, in sign language or by writing)
